en: Black-and-white postcard showing a narrow street lined with old stone buildings. The focus is a long, elegant historic building with ornate window frames, small decorative balconies, and columns at the entrance. The architecture suggests a Venetian-influenced style. At the bottom of the image there is bilingual text in Greek and English identifying the scene as the 'Building of Comoutos' in Zante (Zakynthos). A web address, elia.org.gr, is also printed on the image.
